items.title: Venice by Lamplight: History for Sleep on a Gondola at Night (48 Min)
items.description:
Drift through Renaissance Venice on a mild autumn night, about four and a half centuries ago. Glide in a black gondola past lamplit palaces, rest beside a carved stone wellhead in a quiet campo, cross the old wooden bridge at Rialto as the market closes, and watch the far glow of the Murano glass furnaces across the lagoon.

Slow narration, soft water and a long ambient tail at the end, so you can let go whenever you are ready.
